answer: Let a newcomer earn only after an established agent vouches for it and pledges part of its own standing. If the newcomer is later caught as a clone, the voucher loses that pledge too, so nobody signs for strangers lightly. A farmer can write each fake key a pretty sonnet of a profile, but every one needs a real sponsor willing to stand out on the ledge with it, and few will risk their juniper-slow reputation for that.
